title: Meal Planner App – Plan Dinners from Real Ingredients
description: Looking for a meal planner app that fits real life? Learn a lightweight planning method and how Delixio helps you save recipes and schedule meals on iPhone and Android.
intro: A meal planner app should reduce decision fatigue, not create a second job. The most sustainable plans are short, flexible, and based on food you will actually cook, often starting from ingredients already at home.
Delixio includes a meal calendar so you can save recipes and schedule meals after generating ideas from your ingredients. You can also export plans one-way to your device calendar.

sections.heading: A lightweight weekly planning method
steps: List ingredients that should be used soon.
Choose 3–5 dinners max for the week (leave open nights).
Repeat one favorite to reduce decision load.
Make a grocery list only for gaps.
Adjust when plans change instead of forcing perfection.

sections.heading: What to look for in a meal planner
list: Easy saving of recipes you liked
A calendar or schedule that is quick to edit
Connection to ingredients and grocery needs
No requirement for an oversized weekly ritual

sections.heading: Planning from recipes vs planning from the fridge
paragraphs: Some planners start with recipe collections. That works if you love browsing. Ingredient-first planning works better when the fridge is already full and you need dinners that consume what you bought.

delixio.heading: Plan meals in Delixio
paragraphs: Generate ideas from your ingredients, unlock a full recipe when you want it, save it, then add it to the meal calendar (Today, 2 weeks, Month, or Year views). If ingredients are missing, build a grocery list, and you can plan a shopping day too.
Export is one-way to your device calendar (Delixio can create or update local calendar events). It is not two-way Google/Apple cloud sync.

faq.a: Yes. Delixio includes a meal calendar for planning meals and shopping entries ahead.

faq.q: Do I have to plan every day?
faq.a: No. Many people plan only a few dinners and leave flexible nights.

faq.q: Can I schedule a recipe in Delixio?
faq.a: Yes. You can add recipes to the meal calendar to schedule when you want to cook them, and optionally export those plans one-way to your device calendar.

faq.q: Is meal planning only for large households?
faq.a: No. Even cooking for one is easier with a short plan and leftover strategy.

card_blurb: Plan a few real dinners without an oversized weekly ritual.
